Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
Earlier today I played at a pre-release and someone played a Blessing of Chaos,
talking about how it prevents Chimerstry, Dominate, and Presence action
modifiers, etc. from being played if that minion is trying to block. When I
piped in with "and Dementation cards too," I was refuted that the card text
didn't mention it. I took a real quick glance which seemed to confirm it at the
time. After getting home and checking, it turns out I was right about the
Dementation part (surprise, surprise).

So that just made me curious. Does anyone have a copy of the Camarilla Edition
Blessing of Chaos and if so, could they check to see if it mentions Dementation
cards. I doubt it's a misprint and probably just a case of everyone not looking
at the card text thoroughly enough but I'd just like to check just in case.
Thanks!

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


In general, if a card mentions a discipline or clan whose symbol is
not *already* on the card, the symbol will be included after the
name of the discipline/clan.

If it mentions a discipline or clan whose symbol is already on the
card, the symbol is not repeated.
